train_rl_agent_sac: train a SAC reinforcement learning agent on a PyBullet environment using stable baselines3
train_rl_agent_td3: train a TD3 reinforcement learning agent on a PyBullet environment using stable baselines3
configure_training_timesteps: configure the number of training timesteps for the RL agent via the n-timesteps argument
setup_checkpoint_callback: setup a checkpoint callback to save the RL model every n training steps
run_rl_training_cli: run the RL training CLI module with sac or td3 algorithm on a bullet environment
